name: Merciless (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)
description: Merciless was an EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. The Galactic Empire set a trap for Rebel forces by hiding TIE/LN starfighters among thirteen seemingly abandoned containers and positioning the Merciless nearby to wait for a Rebel recovery operation.
